hkv: תּוֹדִיעֵנִי אֹרַח חַיִּים שֹׂבַע שְׂמָחוֹת אֶת פָּנֶיךָ נְעִמוֹת בִּימִינְךָ נֶצַח
tr: You will make known to me the path of life; in Your presence is fullness of joy; at Your right hand are pleasures forevermore.

s.sum: Rabbi Nachman revealed ten specific psalms that rectify all spiritual damage.
These psalms address all aspects of the soul and all types of spiritual damage.

s.t: The Power of King David's Words
s.sum: King David's psalms contain unique power to elevate and heal the soul.
Reciting these ten psalms daily brings ongoing spiritual protection and elevation.
Through this practice, one connects to Rabbi Nachman and receives his assistance.
